description:
Title: Internship

You can enter a topic that interests you, and how much money you want.
You can also enter experience and hobbies.
Several offers will arrive (at arbitrary points in time).
You can accept or deny offers.
As soon as an offer is accepted, all other offers become invalid.
You have to write at least 3 status updates about your internship (every week).
The company has to write 3 status updates about you.
After the internship is finished you can recommend the company to a list of friends (via twitter).
Separate tweets are sent in parallel.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Internship" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/internship">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Offer" name="Offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Acceptance" name="Offer accepted"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_Internship">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Student" name="Student" processRef="Process_Student"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Company"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer" name="Offer" sourceRef="Task_SendOffer" targetRef="Event_OfferReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Acceptance" name="Acceptance" sourceRef="Task_SendAcceptance" targetRef="StartEvent_AcceptanceReceived"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Student" name="Student internship process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Student" name="Start internship search">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_S1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterProfile" name="Enter topic, desired salary, experience and hobbies">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_S1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_S2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfferMerge" name="Offers merge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_S2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_S7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_S3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OfferReceived" name="Offer received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_S3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_S4</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OfferReceived" messageRef="Msg_Offer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DecideOffer" name="Accept or deny offer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_S4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_S5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfferDecision" name="Offer accepted?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_S5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_S6</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_S7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAcceptance" name="Send acceptance to company">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_S6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_S8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="Sub_Internship" name="Internship">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_S8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_S9</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Internship">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I1</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_StatusUpdate" name="Write weekly status update (at least 3)">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I1</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I2</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics testBefore="false" loopMaximum="3"/>
      </bpmn:userTask>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Internship">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I2</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Internship" targetRef="Task_StatusUpdate"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I2" sourceRef="Task_StatusUpdate" targetRef="End_Internship"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_TweetRecommendation" name="Tweet recommendation to friend (via Twitter)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_S9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_S10</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false"/>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Recommended" name="Company recommended">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_S10</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Student" targetRef="Task_EnterProfile"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S2" sourceRef="Task_EnterProfile" targetRef="Gateway_OfferMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S3" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferMerge" targetRef="Event_OfferReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S4" sourceRef="Event_OfferReceived" targetRef="Task_DecideOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S5" sourceRef="Task_DecideOffer" targetRef="Gateway_OfferDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S6" name="Accepted" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Task_SendAcceptance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>${offerAccepted}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S7" name="Denied" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Gateway_OfferMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>${!offerAccepted}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S8" sourceRef="Task_SendAcceptance" targetRef="Sub_Internship"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S9" sourceRef="Sub_Internship" targetRef="Task_TweetRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S10" sourceRef="Task_TweetRecommendation" targetRef="End_Recommended"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Company internship process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OfferCreated" name="Offer created">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendOffer" name="Send offer to student">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OfferSent" name="Offer sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C2</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_AcceptanceReceived" name="Offer accepted by student">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_AcceptanceReceived" messageRef="Msg_Acceptance"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompanyStatusUpdate" name="Write status update about student (3 times)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C4</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics testBefore="false" loopMaximum="3"/>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CompanyUpdatesDone" name="Status updates completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C4</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="StartEvent_OfferCreated" targetRef="Task_SendOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Task_SendOffer" targetRef="End_OfferSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="StartEvent_AcceptanceReceived" targetRef="Task_CompanyStatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="Task_CompanyStatusUpdate" targetRef="End_CompanyUpdatesDone"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
